description: This PHP source file handles displaying email attachments for Webmails in the vtiger CRM system, including loading email data, generating HTML content to list attachments, and integrating with the web interface.

classes.name: Webmails
classes.description: Represents an email message with methods to load mail details and attachments.

classes.name: MailBox
classes.description: Represents an email mailbox for accessing and managing email folders and messages.

methods.name: loadMail
methods.description: Loads email data, including attachments, into the Webmails object.

methods.name: anchor_arr
methods.description: Array of HTML anchor tags for attachments link generation.
